text_block_list.text:
One evening,
passing by pool area—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, nobody swimming.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Should be able to avoid being seen now...

Despite late hour, horse girl was
trying to enter pool.
Wondering why at this hour—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah~~!!
Found Taishiiin~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: As expected. Perfectly according to prediction.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why...? Didn't tell anyone...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because Taishin hasn't been coming
to pool at all recently!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yet lots of swimsuits in laundry, super weird—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Wait? What was it again, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Despite not attending pool training,
there were traces of swimsuits submitted for laundry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Logically, that indicated possibility of you
visiting pool at night to avoid public eye.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Great Detective Hayahide!
Get it now, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Can't believe you noticed that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of reasoning, training at
hour like this is ill-advised.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Delayed sleep disrupts internal biological clock.
That can lead to reduced concentration, high blood pressure,
and various other complications.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just leave me alone.
Doesn't matter to you what I do anyway.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No way! Not leaving you alone!
If swimming alone, swim with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait... when did you change into swimsuit!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, both are prepared.
I shall act as coach.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, stop. You two are usually
asleep by now. Don't push yourselves—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All reaaaady~~!!
Good to go anytime~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good, Ticket. Start!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, both of you...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh... so sleepy...
*gurgle*... *glub glub*...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... this time should properly be allocated to sleep...!
D-Drowsiness is... taking over...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
H-Heelllp,
Taishiiinnnn... *glub glub*.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, no more... my consciousness... fading...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, seriously?!
I totally knew this would happen...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I told you
"Don't overdo it"...!!

Afterwards, Narita Taishin woke both of them up
and somehow got them back to dorm...
